scope: Targeted successor scenarios augment rather than replace the existing40 L obligations, original26 qualification scenarios,117 candidates or34 V controls.

levels.Q_supplied: Pure supplied-data/fixture mechanism cases under fresh reviewed Q; no candidate or third-party imports.
levels.Q_owned_fixture: Actual bounded project-owned nonnumerical fixtures under fresh reviewed Q, including native construction/loading only when explicitly scoped; no installed package or candidate imports.
levels.P_file_only: Actual fresh preparation under its own admission; source parsing and metadata only, no candidate or third-party execution.
levels.L_actual: Actual installed-loader/ABI/guard/plugin/collection observations under separate fresh L admission; not executable in Q/P.

gates.step: Independent design review and Root design acceptance
gates.claim: Inert design only; no launch or successor byte adoption

gates.step: Implement reviewed lplan2 diagnostic/inventory subset and exact candidate-v2 migration; independent source/comparison review and implementation-specific Root adoption, fresh Q then separate P parser audit
gates.claim: Qualified fixture mechanisms and actual file-only syntax/identity evidence; no imported candidates

gates.step: Build finite source-level binding/effect decisions and transitive closure through reviewed file-only preparation; review provisional pages and explicitly retain pending implementation/capability obligations.
gates.claim: Provisional source-level closure only, not COMPLETE or execution-ready; new modules may add findings and pending capabilities remain blocked.

gates.step: Implement/review lhost2, matching l2, retained streaming interface and L-specific native bootstrap; qualify actual owned-fixture lifecycle and remaining mechanisms under fresh Q
gates.claim: Current implementation Q evidence, not real package compatibility

gates.step: Freeze complete sources/runtime/decisions; verify all joins to implemented qualified capabilities, refresh invalidated Q, aggregate current coverage and P preparation, establish zero unresolved/stale/unbound/conflicting obligations; obtain independent complete-plan semantic/actual reviews and Root complete-plan acceptance.
gates.claim: Complete plan only after implemented capability joins and exact current Q plus physical P; no reuse of stale census and no L admission inferred.

gates.step: Fresh separately admitted L only after all prerequisite obligations pass; independently accept loader/ABI/117-successor collection evidence
gates.claim: L collection only; V117/34 and C remain separately admitted

constraints: All34 new scenarios are unexecuted; cases require concrete reviewed implementations before admission.
Original40 obligations remain mandatory with an explicit implementation-specific method/evidence map; narrow tests cannot silently discharge them.
No source, resource, time, memory, process, output or stop guard is raised by this design.

Q retains90s whole/60s work/5s cleanup and512/768MiB process/Job caps. If a complete suite cannot fit, a separately reviewed bounded cohort/aggregate design is required before admission; no quiet omission or timer extension.
P and L retain300s whole/240s work/5s cleanup and4096/5120MiB caps,4GiB startup/active and20GiB disk. All roles use original intervals and applicable remaining controls.
Implement only supported finite analysis; unknown constructs/refused effects remain blocked. No promise that installed dependencies can be admitted within existing caps.
Real package/resource/ABI/plugin/collection behavior requires L evidence, never fixture substitution.

cases.name: bounded_syntax_diagnostics
cases.required_behavior: Two malformed decorator fixtures produce separately useful bounded coordinates/messages; nullable positions and non-SyntaxError failures remain typed refusals; no source/locals leak.

cases.name: candidate_exact_delta
cases.required_behavior: Accept only two colon deletions and two exact import-prefix changes with byte offsets; refuse any production-byte, parameter, formatting or extra-file change.

cases.name: candidate_identity_map
cases.required_behavior: Require one-to-one 25-function mapping with 39/78 totals and 117 expectations; reject old/new mixed origins and fabricated full node IDs.

cases.name: lexical_binding
cases.required_behavior: Distinguish lexical scopes, closure/global/nonlocal/import aliases and rebindings; unresolved alias or descriptor access cannot receive allow_bound_call.

cases.name: eager_and_deferred_effects
cases.required_behavior: Decorators/defaults/evaluated annotations/class bodies/bases/metaclasses remain eager; dormant body exclusion needs blocked-entry proof including callbacks/generators.

cases.name: implicit_protocol_effects
cases.required_behavior: Inventory operator/truth/iteration/comprehension/context-manager and descriptor effects; unsupported implicit callbacks refuse.

cases.name: exclusion_witness
cases.required_behavior: Reject unsupported branch pruning, stale environment facts and missing invalidation dependencies; true witnesses do not hide eager children.

cases.name: finite_imports
cases.required_behavior: Literal dynamic targets and fully proved star exports are finite; dynamic __all__, undeclared targets, namespace roots and alternate tagged extensions refuse.

cases.name: transitive_fixed_point
cases.required_behavior: A newly discovered module adds all obligations; cyclic groups need reviewed order/guard proof; repeated closure has identical complete digest.

cases.name: effect_certificate
cases.required_behavior: Resolve exact callable, finite argument types/domains and transitive effects; generic include, unbound effects and unknown native callbacks refuse.

cases.name: decision_integrity
cases.required_behavior: Reject duplicated/conflicting/stale/unbound/unused decisions and changed source spans, node hashes or dependencies; no review-rule wildcard grants.

cases.name: artifact_caps
cases.required_behavior: Node/page/output/byte/depth limits include all pages and physical outputs; overflow produces no complete index and preserves bounded refusal evidence.

cases.name: complete_plan_authority
cases.required_behavior: Zero listed refusals alone cannot pass without complete digests, closed effects and independent review; exact current source/runtime/P identities are required.

cases.name: native_helper_role
cases.required_behavior: Exact PNative3 production type/signature is required; old sensor cannot Start; reject stale namespace/assembly/helper bytes before production creation.

cases.name: l_bootstrap_authority
cases.required_behavior: L-specific closed request validates fresh Q/admission/source/runtime chain before dispatch; refuse Q/P schema substitution or stale bootstrap dependency.

cases.name: bootstrap_clock_resources
cases.required_behavior: Actual benign bootstrap respects original clocks, five-second boundary, two samples/spacing/freshness and independent memory/disk/stop guards; no restart of deadlines.

cases.name: two_process_lifecycle
cases.required_behavior: Exercise real owned parent plus one child under nested Job, no third process; verify limit, atomic start, stop, return, streams and full closure.

cases.name: host_partial_failures
cases.required_behavior: Refused launch, missing frame, premature EOF, child failure, timeout and cleanup failure remain sticky; retain partial evidence and never promote unknown custody.

cases.name: p_record_adapter
cases.required_behavior: Accept only declared LP4 schema/status and accepted_physical_index chain; reject accepted_index fallback, mismatched Q, provisional-only result or wrong reviewer relations.

cases.name: physical_identity_required
cases.required_behavior: Compare content-only Root/actual refs exactly, join unique authenticated caller-return output descriptors to those refs and current retained identities; reject missing/duplicate/malformed/identity-less/mismatched descriptors, wrong handoff/operation or rounded integers. Require final verification-before-release.

cases.name: module_manifest_coverage
cases.required_behavior: Reject stale lp1/l1/lhost1 import routes, incomplete active dependency manifest and authority/source/runtime budget overflow; historical preservation is not active authority.

cases.name: retained_large_pe
cases.required_behavior: Use owned synthetic image over64MiB to prove bounded same-handle stream hashing/range parsing and final verification without loading it or buffering whole image.

cases.name: range_parser_adversaries
cases.required_behavior: Negative/bool/overflow/truncated offsets, invalid RVAs, huge tables/forwarders, cache/read-budget excess and changed handles refuse with bounded allocations.

cases.name: shared_native_edges
cases.required_behavior: One image may satisfy several declared importer observations; missing/ambiguous pre-effect choice refuses and notification never invents a requester.

cases.name: frame_and_capability_identity
cases.required_behavior: Frame attribution uses exact code roles, not path prefixes; unimplemented native/resource mediator or unknown caller refuses during materialization and preflight.

cases.name: write_native_resource_denial
cases.required_behavior: Benign fixture verifies owned-output-only writes, denied native resource/process/network branches and no shared cache fallback under declared trust contract.

cases.name: guard_epoch_aliases
cases.required_behavior: Safetensors four APIs and all canonical blockers precede alias capture; missing guards, early aliases, constructor epoch escape and absent sentinels refuse.

cases.name: plugin_pre_effect_gate
cases.required_behavior: Project pytest-like fixture proves exact module/instance hook wrapping before registration and denial before undesired plugin effects; no real pytest import in Q.

cases.name: fresh_file_preparation
cases.required_behavior: Under reviewed caller, parse corrected candidates and materialize current transitive decision inputs without imports/execution; cover all new source/runtime/design artifacts and full final census.

cases.name: real_bootstrap_native_abi
cases.required_behavior: Fresh admitted L observes exact real module/native initialization, finite safe ABI queries and complete native drain/snapshot joins; no numerical ABI or unused path qualification.

cases.name: real_guards_resources_plugins
cases.required_behavior: Fresh admitted L verifies real resource observations, ordered guard sentinels and pinned pytest registration/config identities under complete finite plan.

cases.name: real_collection_identity
cases.required_behavior: Collect exactly117 unique successor IDs and25 function multiplicities with zero test phases; emit exact roster digest for separate V and no old117 execution claim.

cases.name: fresh_census_and_closure
cases.required_behavior: Fixture document addition/removal/change, absent-root change and consumed attempt refuse; final retained output/Job/pipe/guard/caller closure is demonstrated separately.

cases.name: stage_claim_separation
cases.required_behavior: Design/static/supplied/Q/P/L/V/C evidence are distinct; old368 methods,40 scenario rows or117 expectations cannot mark new real obligations executed.
